bars.small: PG room, Mukherjee Nagar. Lights still on.

bars.sung: Teesra attempt, phir se wahi kamra
Ghar se phone aaya, har lafz mein sawaal bhara
bars.en: A call from home. Every word a question.

bars.sung: Raat ke baarah baje, chai bhi thandi padi
bars.en: Midnight. Even the chai went cold.

bars.sung: Feed mein toppers, meri himmat chhoti padi
bars.en: A feed full of toppers. My nerve felt small.

bars.sung: Par tu akela nahi, pod hai saath mein
bars.en: But you're not alone. Your pod is right here.

bars.sung: Aath log, ek sapna, haath haath mein
bars.en: Eight people. One dream. Holding on together.

bars.sung: Pod so gaya? Chotu jaage raat mein
bars.en: Pod asleep? Chotu is up all night.

bars.sung: Doubt ho ya dil bhaari, sun le har baat mein
bars.en: A doubt or a heavy heart, it listens.

bars.sung: Adda bhi free hai, card ki nahi zaroorat
bars.en: The adda is free. No card needed.

bars.sung: Rank ka vaada nahi, bas sachchi sohbat
bars.en: No rank promises. Just real company.

bars.sung: Badge mile haazri pe, pod kare shor
bars.en: Show up, earn a badge. Your pod cheers.

bars.sung: Aaj ke bas teen kaam, aur nahi koi zor
bars.en: Just three things today. No pressure.
